from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Electrons emit secondary waves.",
            "These waves lag behind incident light.",
            "Interference creates resultant wave.",
            "This interaction slows phase velocity.",
            "Phase lag produces index refraction."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Origin: Light-Matter Interaction", lecture_lines)
        
        # Elements
        incident_wave = FunctionGraph(lambda x: 0.5 * np.sin(4 * x), x_range=[-3, 3], color="#FFD700")
        electron = Circle(radius=0.2, color="#00BFFF", fill_opacity=1)
        
        # Initial positions
        self.place_in_area(incident_wave, 'B2', 'B5')
        self.place_at_grid(electron, 'D3')

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#00BFFF"))
        self.play(Create(electron))
        secondary_wave = Circle(radius=0.1, color="#00BFFF", fill_opacity=0.3)
        self.play(GrowFromCenter(secondary_wave))
        self.play(secondary_wave.animate.scale(3).set_opacity(0))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FF8C00"))
        # Visualization of lagging (simple phase shift)
        self.play(incident_wave.animate.shift(LEFT * 0.5))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FF00FF"))
        resultant_wave = FunctionGraph(lambda x: 0.4 * np.sin(4 * x + 0.5), x_range=[-3, 3], color="#FF00FF")
        self.place_in_area(resultant_wave, 'D2', 'D5')
        self.play(Create(resultant_wave))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color("#00FF00"))
        # Indicate slower speed
        self.play(resultant_wave.animate.shift(RIGHT * 0.2))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color("#FFFF00"))
        label = Text("n > 1", font_size=24, color="#FFFF00")
        self.place_at_grid(label, 'F3')
        self.play(Write(label))
        self.wait(2)
